notes: Shared tool contract for every Zotero AI client (Android, desktop plugin). Each entry is an OpenAI Responses API function tool plus x- fields that are not sent to the model. Results are JSON objects whose exact shapes and ordering are defined in tools.md; conformance tests compare them byte-for-byte after normalization.

tools.name: zotero_search_items
tools.description: Search the user's Zotero library for regular items (papers, books, web pages, ...; never attachments, notes or annotations). Every word of the query must match. mode "metadata" (default) looks in the title, author names, year and tags; "everything" also looks in every other field (abstract, publication, DOI, extra, ...), the item's notes, annotations and attachment titles, and the full text of its PDFs and other attachments. Use an empty query with filters to list items. Results are in title order; use offset to page through them.

query.description: Words to look for. May be empty.

tag.description: Only items with exactly this tag.

collection_key.description: Only items directly in this collection.

offset.description: Skip this many results first, to get the next page. Default 0.

mode.description: Where the words are looked for: "metadata" (default) or "everything" (also all fields, notes, annotations and full text).

item_type.description: Only items of this Zotero item type, e.g. journalArticle, preprint, book, conferencePaper.

year_from.description: Only items from this year or later (items without a year are left out).

year_to.description: Only items from this year or earlier (items without a year are left out).

tools.name: zotero_semantic_search
tools.description: Find items by meaning rather than exact words, using the library's semantic search index (full text, abstracts and notes). Use for conceptual questions ("papers about making attention cheaper"); use zotero_search_items for names, titles or exact terms. Returns each item's best matching passages. Items added after the index was built aren't found.

query.description: What to look for, in natural language.

tools.name: zotero_get_item_metadata
tools.description: Get the full metadata of one item: title, authors, date, venue, DOI, URL, abstract, tags, collections and its attachments/notes.

tools.name: zotero_get_item_fulltext
tools.description: Get the extracted full text of an item's PDF/EPUB/snapshot (from Zotero's synced full-text index). Use to read a paper that isn't the one open in the reader. Long texts come in parts: if truncated is true, call again with start set to start + the length of the text you got.

item_key.description: Key of the item or of the attachment itself.

max_chars.description: Truncate to this many characters. Default 20000, max 100000.

start.description: Start at this character offset (0-based). Default 0.

tools.name: zotero_get_collections
tools.description: List all collections in the library with their keys, names, parents and how many items each contains.

tools.name: zotero_get_collection_items
tools.description: List the regular items directly in a collection.

offset.description: Skip this many results first, to get the next page. Default 0.

tools.name: zotero_get_tags
tools.description: List the tags used in the library with how many items carry each.

offset.description: Skip this many results first, to get the next page. Default 0.

tools.name: zotero_get_recent
tools.description: List the most recently added regular items.

tools.name: zotero_get_notes
tools.description: Get notes, either the child notes of one item or notes anywhere whose text contains a query.

item_key.description: Only child notes of this item.

query.description: Only notes whose text contains this (case-insensitive).

offset.description: Skip this many results first, to get the next page. Default 0.

tools.name: zotero_get_annotations
tools.description: Get the highlights, underlines, notes and other annotations the user made on an item's attachments.

item_key.description: Key of the item or of the attachment.

tools.name: zotero_export_items
tools.description: Export items as citation data: CSL-JSON or BibTeX (with citation keys), as zotero.org exports them. Use when the user wants references, a bibliography file or BibTeX entries.

tools.name: zotero_get_pdf_info
tools.description: Get the number of pages in an item's PDF. Use before zotero_get_page_image.

item_key.description: Key of the item or of the PDF attachment.

tools.name: zotero_get_page_image
tools.description: Look at a page of an item's PDF, or part of a page, as an image: figures, tables, equations, diagrams, scanned pages. The image comes with the result. To read a figure closely, look at the whole page first, then ask for the figure's region at a larger width.

item_key.description: Key of the item or of the PDF attachment.

region.description: [x, y, width, height] as fractions (0 to 1) of the page, measured from its top-left corner; null for the whole page.

max_width.description: Width of the image in pixels, 200-2000. Default 1200.

tools.name: zotero_batch_update_tags
tools.description: Add and/or remove tags on one or more items. Requires the user's approval.

tools.name: zotero_set_item_collections
tools.description: Add items to and/or remove them from collections (by collection key). Requires the user's approval.

tools.name: zotero_create_collection
tools.description: Create a collection, optionally inside another one. Requires the user's approval.

tools.name: zotero_create_note
tools.description: Create a note, as a child of an item or standalone. Content is Markdown. Requires the user's approval.

parent_item_key.description: Item to attach the note to; null for a standalone note.

tools.name: zotero_add_item_by_identifier
tools.description: Add a paper or book to the library from a DOI, ISBN, arXiv ID or PMID, retrieving its metadata (and open-access PDF when available). Requires the user's approval.

tools.name: zotero_trash_items
tools.description: Move items to the trash (recoverable). Requires the user's approval.

tools.name: zotero_get_pdf_file
tools.description: Get an item's PDF file itself (up to 25 MB), as an embedded resource.

item_key.description: Key of the item or of the PDF attachment.

tools.name: zotero_await_approval
tools.description: Wait for the user's decision on a change that is waiting for approval in Zotero, and get its result. Use the approval_id from a pending_approval result; don't repeat the original call.
